questions.question:
Identify the odd one:

41, 43, 47, 51, 53, 59
questions.solution:
The other numbers in the given option (41, 43, 47, 53, 59) are all prime numbers, meaning they are only divisible by 1 and themselves. However, 51 is a composite number, as it can be divided by 3 and 17 (3 x 17 = 51)

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**

questions.question:
Which of the following is the odd one out? These options represent sets of numbers following a particular property.

Identify the set that does NOT follow the rule.
questions.solution:
Given Option:

1) 1, 3, 5

 
• 1 is not prime
 
• 3 and 5 are prime

→ Mixed set

2) 9, 15, 21

 
• 9 = composite
 
• 15 = composite

21 = composite**
→ All composite

3) 13, 17, 19

 
• All prime

4) 29, 31, 37

 
• All prime

 

Since only one set contains all composite numbers, it is the odd one out.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2"**

questions.question: Pointing to a boy, a teacher said, "His sister is the daughter of my mother's husband." How is the boy related to the teacher?
questions.solution:
• "His sister is the daughter of my mother's husband."
 
• “My mother’s husband”
 
• This is simply the teacher’s father.
 
• “The daughter of my mother’s husband”
 
• The daughter of the teacher’s father = the teacher’s sister.
 
• “His sister is the teacher’s sister”
 
• The boy’s sister is the teacher’s sister.
 
• So the boy and the teacher share the same sister → they are siblings.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**

questions.question: Pointing to a woman, Rohit says, "She is the daughter of my father's brother's wife." How is the woman related to Rohit?
questions.solution:
• 
 
**Father's brother** = Rohit’s uncle (paternal uncle).

 
 
• 
 
**Father's brother's wife** = Rohit’s aunt (uncle’s wife).

 
 
• 
 
**Daughter of that aunt** = Rohit’s uncle’s daughter → **Rohit’s cousin**.

 
 
• 
 
Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**

questions.question: If [ = +, ] = -, and { = x, then evaluate: 12 { 3 [ 5 ] 7
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/952c967501c582f1911db7fefdaaefa9b6e3f505512624eb925e04e002be5a1f.png] 

Decoding signs:

 
 

 Sign
 [
 ]
 {
 
 

 Stands For
 +
 -
 ×
 
 

Given: 12 { 3 [ 5 ] 7

12 { 3 [ 5 ] 7 ⇒ 12 × 3 + 5 - 7

⇒ __**12 ×**____** 3**__ + 5 - 7

⇒ __**36**____** + 5**__ - 7

⇒ __**41 - 7**__

⇒ 34

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
